_description: Āyah ends where an edition differs from the counting system it follows and no source in data/counting/ records a disagreement inside that system. Each is reported in the edition's file under counting.unexplained and the build fails on any that is not listed here. An entry leaves this list when a source is cited for it (then it moves to khilaf.json) or when the edition is shown to be in error.

findings.note: The KFGQPC Bazzī edition counts ﴿قريبا﴾ and totals 6220. qiraat-ayah-map gives the point to Baṣrī alone, and its attestation notes record al-Dānī reporting it for Baṣrī, not Makkī. Two independent printed sources (this edition and nquran.com) put a Makkī boundary here; reported to qiraat-ayah-map as a likely khilāf within Makkī, uncited as yet.
